question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(AB=5\text{ cm}\), \(BC=6\text{ cm}\), and \(AC=7\text{ cm}\). It is translated \(2\text{ cm}\) in the direction of \(BC\) to obtain \(\triangle DEF\). What is the perimeter of \(\triangle DEF\) in cm?

solutions.explanation: A translation preserves the shape and size of a figure. Thus, \(\triangle DEF\cong\triangle ABC\), and the perimeter is \(5+6+7=18\text{ cm}\).
solutions.title: Preserve side lengths
